variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, medium bold variety suitable for transplanted under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by BINA and released in 2010 for planting in Boro season in saline prone and non-saline areas of Bangladesh. Salinity tolerance. Shattering susceptible. Tolerant to major diseases and insect.
